top10Recommendations.title: Remove Duplicate Mongoose Schema Index on Order Number and Category Name
top10Recommendations.description: Mongoose throws warnings at runtime: Duplicate schema index on {"orderNumber":1}, {"name":1}, {"slug":1} due to specifying both index: true and schema.index().
top10Recommendations.suggestedFix: Remove explicit schema.index() calls where field already has unique: true or index: true.

top10Recommendations.title: Replace Legacy Branding "Dhakad Snazzy" in Notification & CORS Config
top10Recommendations.description: Test notification body contains "This is a test push notification from Dhakad Snazzy!" and socket CORS allowed origins include dhakadsnazzy.com.
top10Recommendations.suggestedFix: Update text strings to "Olovely Total Suvidha" and CORS origins to olovely.com domains.

top10Recommendations.title: Install and Configure i18next for Hindi/Regional Language Support
top10Recommendations.description: The SOW quotation includes Multi-Language / Regional Language support, but i18next is currently not installed.
top10Recommendations.suggestedFix: Install i18next + react-i18next and create en.json / hi.json localization dictionary files.

top10Recommendations.title: Standardize Customer Auth Field Names (phone vs mobile)
top10Recommendations.description: Customer model uses `phone` as primary mobile field while Seller and Delivery use `mobile`. Stale unique indexes on MongoDB collections caused collisions.
top10Recommendations.suggestedFix: Ensure all models use consistent virtual getters or alias `phone` <-> `mobile`.

top10Recommendations.title: Add Webhook Auto-Retry & Idempotency Key in Payment Service
top10Recommendations.description: Webhook handler updates order on payment.captured. Adding an idempotency check prevents duplicate processing if Razorpay retries webhook delivery.
top10Recommendations.suggestedFix: Check if order.paymentStatus is already "Paid" before re-executing stock decrements or wallet credits.

top10Recommendations.title: Optimize Dynamic Category Theme Gradient Transition Latency
top10Recommendations.description: Rapid category switching can cause slight visual repaint delays as gradient CSS variables propagate.
top10Recommendations.suggestedFix: Apply CSS transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) on themed elements.

top10Recommendations.title: Compress Static Uploaded Images via WebP / Sharp Pipeline
top10Recommendations.description: Uploaded product and banner images are stored uncompressed if local storage is used.
top10Recommendations.suggestedFix: Integrate Sharp middleware in multer upload pipeline to auto-convert uploaded images to WebP format.

top10Recommendations.title: Add Client-Side Location Permission Explainer Modal
top10Recommendations.description: When location is blocked or denied, the fallback modal could provide visual instructions to unblock browser location permissions.
top10Recommendations.suggestedFix: Show animated step-by-step tooltip when geolocation error code 1 (PERMISSION_DENIED) is returned.

top10Recommendations.title: Configure PWA Push Notification Action Buttons in Service Worker
top10Recommendations.description: Push notification payloads support action buttons ("Track Order", "View Bill") which enhance customer engagement.
top10Recommendations.suggestedFix: Add action buttons to showNotification() options in firebase-messaging-sw.js.

top10Recommendations.title: Add Automated Stale Session & Temp OTP Cleanup Cron Job
top10Recommendations.description: Expired OTP documents rely on MongoDB TTL index; a daily cleanup worker ensures zero orphan memory overhead.
top10Recommendations.suggestedFix: Add automated cron cleanup job running at midnight.
